findings: Non-blocking: the delegation prompt frames this as a dependency/version alignment fix, but the implemented change contains zero version changes (git status shows only apps/mobile/babel.config.js modified). The fix instead removes a double-applied Reanimated/Worklets Babel plugin. This is justified — a version mismatch was ruled out and the installed stack (reanimated 4.1.7, worklets 0.5.1, gesture-handler 2.28.0, screens 4.16.0, expo 54.0.37, RN 0.81.5) is already SDK-54-compatible — but the scope divergence from the prompt's framing is worth noting.
